_about: A Claude setup token sealed to a host (worker-host/docs/app-host-integration.md 4a). Every input is fixed, so the App and the host must make these exact bytes: the App seals (epk, ct) from host_public_hex, plaintext, agent and nonce with ephemeral_scalar_hex and iv_hex; the host opens them with host_scalar_hex. All values are made up and secure nothing.
scheme: shared = X25519(ephemeral scalar, host public); k = HKDF-SHA256(ikm=shared, salt=epk||host public, info=strugglebus-claude-token v1, L=32); aad = UTF-8(agent + LF + nonce); ct = base64(iv || AES-256-GCM(k, iv, plaintext, aad) || tag16); epk = base64(X25519(ephemeral scalar, 9)); fingerprint = SHA256: + unpadded base64 of SHA-256(host public)
